A1.justification: Both PDFs describe BimArt and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices. Renumbered and relocated content can be matched reliably.

before.justification: V1 reports original ARCTIC and HOI4D experiments, method ablations, and a perceptual study with 55 respondents.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and adds HOI4D comparison results, a nearest-neighbor analysis, and refinement-weight sensitivity results.

M1.justification: The contact and motion diffusion models, articulation-aware representation, guidance, and MANO refinement are retained. Section 3.3 changes the dropped contact-feature symbol from C to Zc, consistent with the existing guidance formulation; this does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate ARCTIC's 11 articulated objects and HOI4D pliers and scissors. The six unseen HOI4D objects displayed in v2 Figure II already appear in v1 Figure 8. The added analyses use existing coverage.

E2.justification: HOI4D Table 2 adds MDM-U w/ opt and OMOMO-U w/ opt to the unified-model comparison. Existing HOI4D comparators, including GraspTTA and ManipNet, and the ARCTIC comparator set are retained.

E3.justification: V2 Appendix D introduces five-nearest-neighbor matching after centering first-frame object vertices and perturbations of each refinement weight within ±25%. Original splits, training budgets, metrics, and user-study design remain unchanged. The additional HOI4D configurations have limited documentation, particularly the distinction between Ours w/ opt and Ours.

E4.justification: Appendix D adds targeted analyses of similarity to training sequences and sensitivity to the acceleration, penetration, and projection weights. Existing representation/contact ablations, BPS mapping analyses, and qualitative generalization examples are retained.

E5.justification: Both versions specify ten generated samples per trajectory for multimodality and the same 55-person user study with z-tests reporting p < 10^-3. V2 adds no seed information, repeated-run reporting, confidence intervals, or uncertainty estimates for the new analyses.

E6.justification: Table 2 adds results for MDM-U w/ opt, OMOMO-U w/ opt, and Ours w/ opt while retaining all earlier values. Appendix D adds mean nearest-neighbor distances of 15.08 cm for hands and 4.40 cm for objects, plus Figure I's sensitivity trends. Original benchmark, ablation, and user-study outcomes remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The method's mathematical definitions and Equations (1)–(12) remain substantively unchanged. The added empirical analyses introduce no new theoretical result, proof, or derivation.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same input assumptions, unified bimanual synthesis contribution, and motion quality/diversity claims. The additional experiments do not redefine these main claims.

C2.justification: Appendix D newly argues against overfitting using nearest-neighbor distances and explains the smoothness–penetration tradeoff revealed by weight perturbations, with contact and articulation relatively insensitive. The existing limitations concerning object-category generalization and sampling speed are retained.

D1.justification: V2 adds a project-page link and descriptions of single-hand HOI4D baseline adaptations. It removes v1's disclosure that each ARCTIC test quartet contains one grasp/relocation-only sequence and three grasp-plus-articulation sequences. Core implementation settings and hardware remain unchanged.

R1.justification: V2 adds Promptable Game Models as reference 45 and explicitly names the previously cited ManiDext as a concurrent exception in Section 2. Other reference changes primarily update publication metadata or formatting; the overall research positioning is retained.

P1.justification: V2 lightly edits prose and terminology, abbreviates affiliations, adds acknowledgements, and replaces the numbered appendix overview with a Supplementary Material heading. The main narrative and section organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: Table 2 expands and updates ranking highlights, and a new three-panel sensitivity figure appears. Existing figures are resized or relocated, notably the enlarged HOI4D examples moving from Figure 8 to Figure II. Original figure content is retained, with appendix tables and figures renumbered.

improvement.justification: The expanded HOI4D comparison and new sensitivity analysis modestly strengthen the empirical assessment and clarify refinement tradeoffs. The nearest-neighbor check provides limited additional evidence against copying training examples. These gains are tempered by the underexplained Ours w/ opt row and removal of the ARCTIC test-composition detail; the main method and original evidence remain stable.
